results.title: Saudi recalls 109 Aston Martin SUVs over suspension defect
results.description: The Ministry of Commerce has recalled 109 Aston Martin DBX and DBX 707 vehicles due to a defect in the rear suspension system mounting bolts that increases the risk of losing control of the vehicle. The default may damage the lower rear suspension arm that increases the risk of losing control of the vehicle and causing a crash. The recall affects 109 Aston Martin DBX and DBX 707 vehicles from the 2021–2026 model years. The ministry urged owners to verify whether their vehicles are included in the recall by checking their Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) through Recalls.sa. Customers were also advised to contact Al Haj Hussain Ali Reza Co. to have the necessary repairs carried out free of charge.

results.title: NCM warns El Niño likely to persist through early 2027
results.description: The National Center for Meteorology (NCM) and the Climate Change Center (CCC) said indicators point to a growing likelihood that El Niño conditions will develop and persist through the end of 2026 and into early 2027, bringing warmer temperatures and shifting rainfall patterns across Saudi Arabia. The agencies said Saudi Arabia is currently in a neutral phase of the El Niño-Southern Oscillation (ENSO), with the Niño 3.4 Index standing at +0.39°C as of July 5. Forecast models indicate a high probability that El Niño will develop, with the index expected to exceed +0.8°C and reach around +1.25°C, with the possibility of strengthening into a strong El Niño. Forecasts also indicate the Niño 3.4 sea surface temperature anomaly will continue to rise, increasing from +1.1°C in May to +2.8°C by October. Western Saudi Arabia is also expected to see an increased likelihood of rainfall and a higher risk of flash floods during the autumn season, while parts of central Saudi Arabia could receive rainfall during the 2026-2027 winter season. The southwestern highlands may also experience above-average rainfall next spring. results.title: Ukrainian drones kill 5, set buildings ablaze in Russian city
results.description: MOSCOW — Ukraine fired hundreds of drones at the ​southern Russian city of Rostov-on-Don early Monday, killing five people, including a child, according to Russian officials.The attack also set buildings ablaze, among them an apartment block and warehouses, officials said.Regional governor Yuri Slyusar said Russian air defense forces had ​shot down around 50 Ukrainian drones over his ⁠region while Kyivtargeted the cities ​of Rostov, Taganrog and four districts in the region including ​Chertkovsky, Tarasovsky, Sholokhovsky and Millerovsky.Eight people had been injured in Rostov, one of whom was in a critical condition, he said ​in a statement. In the port city of ​Taganrog, which lies on the Sea of Azov and is home ‌to ⁠various industrial facilities and a grain terminal, he said an unnamed production facility had been damaged.Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said his forces had struck an export terminal in the western Rostov region, as well as oil facilities in the Yaroslavl and Udmurtia regions far from the front line.“Last night, our long-range sanctions were effective in the Rostov region. An export terminal approximately 250 kilometers from the front line was hit,” Zelensky said in a post on Facebook.“Deep strikes also targeted oil facilities in the Yaroslavl region and the Udmurt Republic, which is 1,300 kilometers from Ukraine’s state border,” he added.The five reported killed were all in Russia's Rostov region bordering Ukraine.Among the dead were a married couple and a child, while the attack damaged multiple buildings including a homeless shelter, Slyusar said."This is an irreparable loss for us all... Emergency service personnel and rescue teams are working at the scene," he said.In the Belgorod region bordering Ukraine, Ukrainian drones wounded 12 people including two children and set fire to an apartment building, regional authorities said.Russian air defences intercepted 276 drones during the night, Russia's defence ministry said.Ukraine has escalated its retaliatory strikes on Russia in recent months, partly to pressure Moscow to the negotiating table after nearly four-and-a-half years of war.Last month was the deadliest for civilians in Ukraine since April 2022, as Moscow ramped up its long-range strikes on towns and cities across Ukraine, according to the United Nations.Russian strikes on Ukraine wounded at least four people early Monday, including an 88-year-old woman who suffered burns across much of her body, according to regional officials.

results.title: Prince Mansour represents Saudi Crown Prince at Maldives Independence Day celebration
results.description: MALÉ — On behalf of Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, Prince Mansour bin Miteb, Minister of State, Member of the Council of Ministers, and Adviser to the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques, attended the Republic of Maldives' 61st Independence Day celebration. **media[2742804]** During the celebration on July 26, held in the capital, Prince Mansour met with Maldivian President Dr. Mohamed Muizzu and conveyed the congratulations of the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman and Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman on the occasion. **media[2742802]** He also conveyed their best wishes to the government and people of the Maldives for continued progress and prosperity. The celebration was also attended by the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques' Ambassador to the Republic of Maldives, Yahya bin Hassan Al-Qahtani. **media[2742805]**

results.title: عبر «نور».. التعليم تعتمد نتائج حركة النقل الداخلي للمعلمين والمعلمات
results.description:
اعتمدت وزارة التعليم رسمياً نتائج حركة النقل الداخلي للمعلمين والمعلمات، وبدأت بنشرها تدريجياً عبر نظام «نور» الإلكتروني. ودعت الوزارة المستفيدين لمتابعة حساباتهم للاستعلام عن النتائج واستكمال الإجراءات اللاحقة.

ويجري العمل حالياً على رفع النتائج واعتمادها إلكترونياً في النظام لإتاحة الاطلاع عليها بشكل كامل.

وتأتي هذه الخطوة استكمالاً لجهود الوزارة وتأكيداً لما نشرته «اليوم» في وقت سابق.

ودعت الوزارة جميع المتقدمين والمتقدمات إلى متابعة حساباتهم الشخصية في نظام «نور» لمعرفة حالة طلبات النقل الداخلي. مؤكدة أهمية استكمال أي إجراءات لاحقة وفق الضوابط والتعليمات المعتمدة بعد ظهور النتيجة.
